description: Buyer shifts at the baseline's yields and primary fiscal path. Banks, foreign accounts or a separately routed money-fund position acquire $500 billion of Treasury holdings in fiscal year 2027 and maintain the added position through September 2031. All cases share one baseline. Ordinary money funds use covered deposits.
boundaries: Illustrative scenario accounting, not a forecast or causal estimate
The $500 billion size is a stated assumption, equal across buyers so their effects can be compared, not an estimated demand response

Yields and the primary fiscal path are the baseline's. Federal Reserve remittances respond to the Fed's income, so a position that changes the Fed's balance sheet, such as the one funded from money-fund ON RRP, changes remittances and therefore Treasury's issuance. The holders who give up the position hold that debt difference in their donor weights; every other holder keeps its stated target
Positions are exact at each daily period close, after the Federal Reserve's operation; this is a model clock, not literal market execution on every calendar day

The added position is total controlled public marketable Treasury holdings at par (adjusted principal for TIPS), acquired and maintained through nominal bills; it is not exactly $500 billion more bills
Every scenario puts the TGA on the operating-cash path at each fiscal-year end, so financing-cost differences change the debt rather than the TGA
Banks settle with reserves and foreign holders settle through US banks outside covered deposits.
Ordinary money funds use covered deposits. The added position uses covered deposits or money-fund ON RRP.

At opening households hold $500 billion more money-fund shares and $500 billion fewer deposits. Reserves are $500 billion lower and money-fund ON RRP is $500 billion higher in every role. The opening exchange is outside the Treasury flow measures.

calibration.size: $500 billion, about 1.6 percent of marketable debt at the opening, for every buyer.
calibration.timing: Zero at the 2026-09-30 close, rising linearly to $500 billion at the 2027-09-30 close, held at $500 billion through 2031-09-30.
calibration.displacement: Banks and foreign buyers displace the other ordinary holder routes. For either money-fund case, banks, foreign holders and other domestic nonbanks give up the position. Donor weights use their realized bill holdings in the baseline at the 2026-09-30 close. Ordinary money funds follow their baseline path in both money-fund cases, and the added route acquires securities only in controller trades.
calibration.trading: After the Federal Reserve's operation each day, holders above their target sell nominal bills to holders below it at model dirty prices; each sale is spread across remaining-maturity buckets in proportion to the seller's bills.

scenarios.label: Banks hold $500 billion more Treasury securities, paid with reserves
Foreign accounts hold $500 billion more Treasury securities, settled through US banks
Money funds hold $500 billion more Treasury securities, paid from deposits
Money funds hold $500 billion more Treasury securities, paid from ON RRP
